title: Brazilian Sweet Rice Gratin
description: A sweet and creamy Brazilian-inspired rice gratin that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish combines the richness of sweet rice with the crunch of a crispy topping.

ingredients.name: gratin
ingredients.notes: preferably a sweet bread or brioche

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the sweet rice and coconut milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the brown sugar and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes or until the sugar dissolves.
Stir in the flour to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually pour the coconut milk mixture into the roux, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until it thickens.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange the cooked sweet rice in an even layer.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the rice and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the grated gratin over the top of the rice mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the gratin is golden brown and the rice is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
